subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CEASE
solution: The correct answer is '**start**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Cease**' is '**Start**'. • **Cease**: to stop or end. (समाप्‍त होना या करना; रुकना या रोकना) • *Example: Fighting in the area has now **ceased**.* • **Start**: to begin doing something. (कुछ करना आरंभ करना) • *Example: We’ll have to **start **early to catch the bus.* **Correct Answer:__** *start.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **stop**: (of an event, action, or process) come to an end; cease to happen. (विराम) • **catch**: to take hold of something that is moving, usually with your hand or hands. (हाथों में लेना; पकड़ना; थामना) • **halt**: a short stop in some activity, movement, or growth. [(कार्य, गतिविधि या विकास प्रक्रिया में) लघु विराम या रुकाव] 3f:T1175, The erroneous part is **'The elegance furnished'.**
